author: bevelui
description:
An architecture and design-build studio template, built around a WebGL hero that refracts its own headline through a faceted crystal — real transmission with chromatic dispersion, not a blur filter. The headline is rendered inside the 3D scene, so the glass bends the actual type.

No external assets: no 3D models, no HDRI maps, no textures, no stock photography. The crystal, the lighting rig, the drifting motes and the project plates are all generated in code — nothing to license, nothing to host, nothing that breaks in two years.

Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4 and Motion. Adaptive quality tiers scale by device, rendering pauses when the hero scrolls off-screen, reduced motion is fully respected, and every text colour is measured to WCAG AA.

How you receive it: after checkout you connect your GitHub account, then accept an invitation to the private repository. Two quick steps and you have lifetime access, including every future update. Use it on unlimited sites, client work included.
